verdict.rationale: Anytype's offline-first local storage is well documented (all content stored locally, works fully offline) and its 'Query' feature lets users define criteria to filter/assemble results by properties and tags, which covers filter-based retrieval. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents a full-text search capability across notes, nor filtering by 'paths' (Anytype is object-based, not file/path-based), so the story's exact search mechanics are only partially evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit full-text search documentation, path-based filtering, and independent/hands-on confirmation that search works well offline.
